findings.description: F001 introduces a fixture_only exemption where seeded-only evidence is not satisfied but also does not block. The objective contract says declared consumer outcomes on activated product-class or consumer-journey-bearing plans block unless satisfied, structurally deferred, or dispositioned, and seeded-only journeys fail. fixture_only is not listed as an allowed close bypass.
findings.recommendation: Remove the fixture_only close bypass, or explicitly model fixture_only as a structured deferral/disposition path with the same {journey, consumer} accountability required by the contract.

findings.description: F001 still contains stale posture wording that says the pure posture function returns block|advisory by goal_type and that internal substrate plans are advisory unless opted in. That conflicts with the objective's D030/D043 rule that any consumer-journey-bearing plan, including substrate, blocks an undeferred unproven outcome.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite the remaining summary text so posture is driven by activation plus consumer-journey presence/product metadata, with substrate advisory only for opted-in substrate plans with no consumer journeys.

findings.description: The posture matrix statement says enforcement_posture returns block when active and product-class goal_type or product metadata is present, even when has_consumer_journey is false. The objective requires product-class plans with no declared consumer journey to emit no_consumer_journey_declared as advisory and not block close.
findings.recommendation: Pin the matrix cells for product-class/no-consumer-journey as active with advisory no_consumer_journey_declared and no close block, distinct from block-eligible cells with declared unproven journeys.
